prompt: Challenge C145-CH1: Our adtech platform inserts pre-roll ads into podcast episodes, but the targeting is purely demographic; click-through rates are stuck at 0.

content.text:
Let me analyze the challenge and researchers.

Core work: Build a content-embedding/topic-classification layer that matches podcast episode transcripts to ad intent signals to improve CTR - requires NLP/ML engineering skills.

Researchers:
- R0820 (Ivković): Marketing/pricing economist, conjoint analysis, hedonic pricing. No NLP/ML engineering. Cannot build the system.
- R0931 (Zahorecová): NLP, semantic embeddings, audio metadata classification, content recommendation - perfect match. But notes say available earliest mid-2027, and the challenge needs delivery in 6 months.
- R0925 (Petrović): NLP, transformer models, embeddings - good match technically. Allowed: joint_project, industrial_phd. No industry experience noted.
- R0443 (Tóth): Marketing/consumer behaviour, e-commerce background - not relevant to NLP engineering work.
- R0083 (Milošević): Speech technology/ASR specialist, not text classification/embedding for ad targeting.

Rethinking R0931: her availability notes explicitly state she can't start new projects before mid-2027, which rules her out given the 6-month delivery window - marking her as unable to take this on despite being the strongest technical fit.

R0925 can handle the embedding/classification work, but only through joint_project or industrial_phd arrangements since his terms don't allow direct contract research - joint_project seems the better fit here given the €18k, 6-month scope.

Confirming R0820 and R0443 are both out due to mismatched expertise (economics/consumer behavior rather than NLP), while R0083's ASR skills don't address the classification problem even though transcripts are involved.
